records.title: Before the test: altitude-chamber training
records.description: An official NASA catalogue record describes Apollo 1 prime-crew training in an altitude chamber.
records.limit: This training record is not a photograph of the January 27 fire or its recorded seconds.

records.title: Command Module 012 before the accident
records.description: NASA's catalog identifies the spacecraft during preflight preparations.
records.limit: This is an earlier processing image, not the emergency or the accident investigation's instrument timeline.

records.kind: Primary historical investigation · no event photograph claimed
records.title: The actual event: Review Board evidence
records.description: The Board recorded the fire during the plugs-out ground test, hazardous cabin conditions and the inability to determine one conclusive ignition source.
records.limit: No archival photograph in this gallery depicts the recorded fire or the Board's individual instrument time marks.

records.kind: Museum exhibit photograph record · retrospective context
records.title: The hatch preserved for public memory
records.description: The existing FV Atlas cites a 2017 NASA museum photo of the preserved Apollo 1 hatch.
records.limit: The museum exhibit is fifty years after the fire; it must not be placed on the 1967 event timeline as event imagery.
